## How to Display the WooCommerce Cart Icon in Menu bar?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-display-the-woocommerce-cart-icon-in-menu-bar/>

Firstly, you need to activate the **WooCoomerce Plugin** to display the WooCommerce cart icon in menu bar. Then,

- Go to **Appearance** > **Customize > WooCommerce > Design**
- Go to **Cart Icon.**
- Put a checkmark on **Check to show WooCommerce cart icon on menu bar.**
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Select Product Page Layout?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-select-product-page-layout/>

Spacious theme provides the option to change the layout for the WooCommerce Product page. Firstly, you need to activate the WooCommerce plugin then follow the steps listed below to make the changes in the WooCommerce Archive page:

- From the WordPress Dashboard, navigate to **Appearance > Customize > WooCommerce > Sidebar**
- Scroll to **Product Page layout**
- Choose the option.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Select Archive Page Layout ?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-select-archive-page-layout/>

Spacious theme provides the option to change the layout for the WooCommerce archive page. Firstly, you need to activate the WooCommerce plugin then follow the steps listed below to make the changes in the WooCommerce Archive page:

- From the WordPress Dashboard, navigate to **Appearance > Customize > WooCommerce > Sidebar**
- Go to** Archive Page layout**
- Choose the option.
- Click on **Publish**.
